content:
For a truck block starting at position \(i\), the car block may start at any position except \(i-1,i,i+1\). Counting valid car-block starts:

\[
\begin{array}{c|ccccccc}
i & 1&2&3&4&5&6&7\\
\hline
\text{valid starts} &5&4&4&4&4&4&5
\end{array}
\]

Total:

\[
5+4+4+4+4+4+5=30
\]

\[
\boxed{30}
\]
